name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair’s journey into motorsport marketing began unconventionally, with a background in graphic design and a lifelong passion for racing. He honed his skills designing liveries for local racing teams before transitioning into a full-time marketing role. His innovative approach and keen eye for detail quickly set him apart. He joined Reiza Studios Factory, drawn to their commitment to authentic simulation. 

Alistair believes in creating marketing campaigns that resonate with genuine racing enthusiasts. He’s not interested in superficial hype; his focus is on highlighting the technical intricacies and visceral thrills of motorsport. Alistair is known for his ability to translate complex engineering concepts into compelling narratives, making him a crucial bridge between the technical team and the wider audience. His perfectionism ensures every campaign is polished to the highest standard, reflecting the team's dedication to excellence.

What makes Alistair distinctive is his 'analog' approach in a digital world. He insists on sketching campaign ideas on paper before touching a computer, believing it fosters creativity. He also maintains a collection of vintage motorsport posters, using them as inspiration for modern campaigns, adding a touch of classic appeal to the team's marketing efforts.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed-over with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pencil for jotting down ideas.
Insists on playing bagpipe music softly in his office, claiming it stimulates creativity.
Has a habit of rearranging the office furniture to optimize 'marketing feng shui'.
